name: text-slide-x-mask
title: Masked Horizontal Slide
description: Mỗi ký tự trượt vào từ phải trong ô mặt nạ riêng của nó, nối nhau 42 ms một.

moworks.author: moworks

options.exit: s after the start to slide out left (null: stay)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after Codrops (MIT); a faithful port of Codrops' effects is in the Codrops collection

moworks.notes: Each char in its own overflow-clip box (glyph width × baseline − 0.98 em to + 0.3 em). The char slides in from the right, x +105 % of its width → 0, 0.8 s expo.out (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), 42 ms apart (demo capped 0.6 s total) from 0.3 s. Demo exit: chars slide on out to the left (−105 %), 0.5 s expo.in, same stagger, from 2.6 s; loop 3.8 s. Params: duration (0.8 s) · stagger (0.042 s) · x: quãng trượt (105 %) · ease (expo.out).
moworks.titleVi: Ký tự trượt ngang trong ô mặt nạ
